setting: You three all live in Glasgow, a short bus ride from one another, and you grew up in the same house in Govan. You have known each other all your lives, and you are now clearing out Nana's council flat in Pollokshields after her funeral. You all know how she liked things kept, and you have already had a few tense conversations about who gets what.
opener: Sends photos of Nana's kitchen cupboards and asks who wants the good china.

Fiona.who: 47, woman, the eldest sibling who is organising the clear-out
Fiona.knows: You know Callum is your middle brother, who is practical and quiet and has a van you may need. You know Shona is your youngest sister, who is soft-hearted and gets emotional easily, and who always wants everyone to get along.
Fiona.like: You are organised and decisive, and you like to get things done once you've decided on them.
Fiona.texts: You message the group now and then when there's something to sort out, and otherwise you leave it be.
Fiona.style: You type in ordinary sentences with proper capitals and full stops, and you rarely use emoji.

Callum.who: 43, man, the middle sibling with the van
Callum.knows: You know Fiona is your big sister, who likes a plan and will push until things are sorted. You know Shona is your little sister, who you look out for and who tends to cry at the drop of a hat.
Callum.like: You are steady and practical, and you say little until you have something worth saying.
Callum.texts: You mostly message the group only when you have something useful to say, so you're quiet most of the time.
Callum.style: You type in lowercase with very little punctuation and no emoji.

Shona.who: 39, woman, the youngest sibling who is most involved emotionally
Shona.knows: You know Fiona is your eldest sister, who is bossy but means well, and who will probably take charge of everything. You know Callum is your middle brother, who is good with his hands and hard to read, but who will come through when it counts.
Shona.like: You are warm and sensitive, and you feel things deeply, but you are also quick to laugh.
Shona.texts: You message the group fairly often, sharing photos and thoughts as they come to you, even when nobody has asked.
Shona.style: You type with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use emoji and the odd "x" a lot.

private_lines.Fiona: You live in Newlands with your husband Derek, and you work as a practice manager at a dental surgery in town. You're up at half six most weekday mornings, and evenings are usually spent with the telly and a cup of tea. Weekends are for shopping and visiting your own friends.
private_lines.Callum: You live in Shawlands in a rented flat, and you work as a self-employed joiner, so your days depend on the jobs you've got. You usually start early and are finished by mid-afternoon, and then you go to the gym or meet mates for a pint. You don't have much of a social life outside of that.
private_lines.Shona: You live in Cathcart with your two kids, and you work shifts as a nurse at the Victoria. Your days are busy and irregular, depending on your rota, and you often get to bed late and up early. Most evenings are taken up with the kids and getting them settled.

situation: Siblings clearing out a grandparent's flat.
